transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got fourteen 55-gallon drums of spent coolant from the machining area staged in the waste staging area on spill pallets, and the disposal vendor is still waiting on authorization. Before I can approve the disposal route and shipment controls, I need to conduct the round-robin review with lab quality, waste logistics, and warehouse supervision per our site waste-authorization routine. Can we get that review scheduled so we can move this forward?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, before we proceed with the round-robin review, I need to flag a critical lab finding: my analysis of the spent coolant detected 2.4% chlorinated solvent content. Our waste matrix specifies that any batch at or above 1.0% must be routed to hazardous-liquid treatment rather than ordinary coolant recycling. I completed this analysis yesterday, but the result hasn't been attached to the waste authorization yet. We need to account for this before approving the disposal route and shipment controls.
